name: 10 changed api sources have no mapped test — gate is pinned at require_approval (medium) every shift
description:
## Why this card exists
`qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=false)` returns `require_approval` / medium / 11 findings on every shift, and 10 of them are the same `change.missing-tests` on api sources. Nothing owns them: `448b0447` covers only the 9 client modules, `e5841226` is about the false-green collection, `cdff59e2` is about the 3 red tests. So the medium finding repeats forever and the gate can never reach `allow`.

## Measured evidence (shift 6, 2026-11-19T09:28Z)
- changed_files 400, test_files 146, mapped_sources 40, **unmapped_sources 70** (shift 5: 220 / 144 / 35 / 58 — the tree roughly doubled in one day).
- The findings list truncates at 11, so the gate cannot even display all 70. Top of the list, all medium:
  api/codx/junior/api/browser_models.py, browser/actions.py, browser/activity.py, browser/browser_manager.py, browser/recorder.py, chat/chat_engine.py, computer/custom_images.py, db.py, global_settings.py, media/providers/voice_openai.py
  (truncated remainder: security/ciso/policy.py, security/user_management.py, tools/browser_tools.py, tools/ciso_tools.py, tools/dockerhub_tools.py, tools/project_manager_tools.py, tools/repository_tools.py, tools/voice_tools.py, client/src/api/connection.js, client/src/api/modules/browsers.js)

## What to do (two acceptable ways out, per file)
1. Add a test whose filename names the module (the mapper matches on the module name), or
2. Declare the path in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` **with a written reason** — only for files that genuinely need no unit test.

Do not batch-declare the 8 `tools/*.py` files just to make the gate green: that is the tool registry, i.e. exactly the surface the harness cards are about.

## Acceptance criteria
- `qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=false)` returns at most 1 finding (the truncation notice is expected while unmapped > 10), or
- every remaining unmapped path is listed in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a reason, quoted in the closing comment.
- Work in small batches (one module + its test per turn): shift 5 proved long runs get cut after the read phase.

## Command that proves it
qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=false)
